project.name: youtube-sniffer
project.summary: Three scraping scripts extract historical YouTube playlist metadata or Chinese video-site counts into CSV/text workflows; inputs and outputs are local runtime files not included in the repository.

nodes.label: Playlist and site CSV collection
nodes.summary: Main script traverses playlists and Chinese-site lists to build a dated CSV.

nodes.label: YouTube metadata CSV
nodes.summary: Reuses playlist ID extraction and writes OpenGraph metadata for every listed video.

nodes.label: Tencent request experiment
nodes.summary: A separate top-level loop uses requests, browser-like headers and a delay.

nodes.label: External video pages
nodes.summary: HTML selectors depend on historical public site markup, not stable API contracts.

edges.label: Fetch channel playlist and video pages
edges.description: Fetch channel playlist and video pages.

flows.title: Build a metadata CSV from playlist URLs

steps.note: Read playlist URLs from a separately supplied local text file.
Extract data-video-id attributes from playlist table rows.
Fetch each watch page, collect title, description and tags, and write a CSV row.
Supply HTML whose selectors must still match for the script to work.

flows.title: Build the combined historical view-count report

steps.note: Read playlist inputs, request channel pages and enumerate playlist video IDs.
Return watch-page titles/counts and Youku/Tencent page fields.
Write playlist and Chinese-site sections to a date-named CSV, delaying Tencent requests.

tour.title: Files, not an HTTP service
tour.note: The scripts declare no inbound handlers. Input lists and generated CSVs are runtime artifacts outside the code map; none was opened or created.

tour.title: A real helper connection
tour.note: metasniffer imports playListSniff from sniffyoutube. No integration with the separate Tencent experiment is present.

tour.title: Historical selectors remain unvalidated
tour.note: chinaTest executes a file-reading/network loop at import time. No source module was imported. The commented-out chinaSina sketch is not an active function despite heuristic scanner symbol output.
